environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on EKS cluster (v1.27) in namespace 'webapp-prod'. Calico CNI with GlobalNetworkPolicy applied. A namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy named 'restrict-metadata-egress' uses spec.egress rules that deny traffic to CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on all ports. However, the policy's podSelector matches label 'app: webapp-flask' and the spec.policyTypes includes only ['Egress']. Ingress is unrestricted. The pod template carries label 'app: webapp-flask'. Note: the NetworkPolicy allows egress to 0.0.0.0/0 EXCEPT the metadata CIDR via a combination of two egress rules (0.0.0.0/0 with 169.254.0.0/16 excluded using 'except' field in ipBlock). DNS egress on port 53 is explicitly allowed to kube-dns.

config.ingress: ALB ingress controller, no WAF attached
